QuestInfo.name: The Missing Weapon
QuestInfo.0: You should talk to #b#p1202002##k on your way back to town.
QuestInfo.1: #p1202002# tells you it's an honor to meet a real hero and pleads with you to say hello to his brother #b#p1202003##k, who's also eager to meet a hero.
QuestInfo.2: #p1202003# said you are wielding a rather common weapon for a hero. Were you really a hero?

0.0: I just heard someone say, 'The hero has returned!' Did I hear wrong, or is it... is it really true? So this... this person standing before me is the hero?!
0.2: Oh, this is unreal... I can't believe I am staring right at a hero of Maple World! It's an honor! Here, let me shake your hand... and if you could give me a hug... Heehee, could you please sign this, too?
0.3: Ah, I'm so sorry. I was so happy to have finally met you that I guess I got a little carried away. Whew, deep breaths. Deep breaths. Okay, I feel better now. But um...can I ask you a favor? Please?

yes.0: My brother #b#p1202003##k is just down the street, and he's been dying to meet you! I know you're busy, but could you please stop by and say hello to #p1202003#? Please...

no.0: Ah, okay. I understand. Heroes are very busy and all that. *sniffle*... If you ever get any free time, though...

npc.0: You haven't talked to #b#p1202003##k yet? He's riiight there. Are you nervous about approaching a fan? I never knew heroes could be so shy...
